ValidationRule.description: An approved request is settled: its balance is spent and its bookings exist. Editing it rewrote the day count without re-deducting, so record and balance drifted apart. Rejecting is allowed and reverses everything; deleting is too.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This request has been approved and cannot be changed. Reject it to release the balance and clear its calendar and timesheet entries, then raise a new request - or delete it.
